name: genesis-tools-mods
description: Claude Code mods for GenesisTools: draws the whole diff of a Bash call whose diff-hook message was cut, with Claude Code's own diff element, under the call's row, adds the model a subagent runs on to its description, so the agents panel and its finished line name it, and compacts an idle session before its 1-hour prompt cache expires. Configured in the hooks file: tools agents hooks config set mods.fullDiff|mods.idleCompact true|false.
